description: Public scenario manifest for first-class activity conformance. Harnesses use these scenario ids and criteria when evaluating published Durable Workflow artifacts across workflow-embedded and standalone activity execution.

published_artifact_install_only.expected_behavior: all artifacts are resolved from published channels and no local product checkout is used as an artifact under test

workflow_embedded_activity_result.expected_behavior: a workflow-scheduled activity completes through the worker protocol and the workflow observes the exact typed result

standalone_activity_result.expected_behavior: a top-level activity started through POST /api/activities closes its host run with the activity result

durable_result_recording_after_worker_re.expected_behavior: activity result recording survives worker restart and replay does not duplicate completion

retry_attempt_backoff_behavior.expected_behavior: failed attempts increment attempt state, respect configured backoff, and complete or fail according to retry policy

timeout_behavior.expected_behavior: start-to-close or schedule-to-close deadline is visible to the worker and enforced as a typed timeout

typed_failure_propagation.expected_behavior: activity failures preserve type, message, and details through history and the caller runtime

heartbeat_and_cancellation_observation.expected_behavior: activity heartbeat details are recorded and cancellation is observable by a running worker

heartbeat_timeout_renewal_across_enforce.expected_behavior: an exact published PHP SDK worker renews the authoritative heartbeat deadline across repeated real timeout-enforcement passes, completes once without contradictory timeout history, and a no-heartbeat control retains typed timeout and deterministic stale-attempt responses

idempotent_completion_handling.expected_behavior: duplicate completion attempts do not create duplicate terminal records and return a deterministic worker-protocol response

php_python_activity_parity.expected_behavior: PHP and Python activity workers produce compatible payload, failure, retry, timeout, and heartbeat observations where both runtimes support the surface

operator_visible_activity_attempt_state.expected_behavior: operators can see current and historical activity attempt state through API metrics, Waterline, and CLI JSON list/detail output

scenarios.title: Published artifact install only
operations: install the server image, CLI, Python SDK, PHP workflow runtime, and Waterline from published channels
record the resolved artifact name, version, and source for every actor
prove local product source checkouts were not used as artifacts under test
pass_criteria: all claimed actors start from published artifacts only
the result document records artifact versions and a generated_at timestamp for every claimed actor
no scenario step depends on repository-local implementation tests

scenarios.title: Workflow embedded activity result
operations: start a workflow that schedules an ordinary activity on the shared activity task queue
complete the activity through the worker activity-task protocol
resume the workflow and capture the final run result plus activity history events
pass_criteria: the activity task includes workflow id, run id, activity type, attempt id, and payload codec
the workflow receives the exact typed result returned by the activity worker
history records ActivityStarted and ActivityCompleted for the same activity execution id

scenarios.title: Standalone activity result
operations: start a top-level activity through the public activity control-plane route
complete it through the same worker activity-task protocol used by embedded activities
read the activity handle and host run after completion
pass_criteria: the control-plane handle exposes activity_id, activity_execution_id, workflow_run_id, workflow_type, and task queue
the host run closes with the exact activity result
the activity listing and detail surfaces show the terminal activity state

scenarios.title: Durable result recording after worker restart
operations: complete an activity and stop the worker process before the caller observes the result
restart the worker with the same logical task queue
resume the workflow or standalone host and inspect history for duplicate activity completions
pass_criteria: the recorded result survives the worker restart
the caller observes the original result after restart
no duplicate activity execution or duplicate completion event is created

scenarios.title: Retry attempt and backoff behavior
operations: start an activity with an explicit retry policy
fail the first attempt with a retryable typed failure
measure redelivery attempt number and backoff timing before completing a later attempt
pass_criteria: attempt identifiers change between attempts while the activity execution id remains stable
observed redelivery respects the configured backoff window
operator-visible state reports the current attempt and retry state

scenarios.title: Timeout behavior
operations: start an activity with start-to-close or schedule-to-close timeout configuration
observe the deadline surfaced to the worker or server timeout scanner
allow the timeout to fire and capture terminal history
pass_criteria: the timeout deadline is visible in worker or operator evidence
the server records a typed timeout rather than an unclassified failure
the caller observes the documented timeout outcome

scenarios.title: Typed failure propagation
operations: fail an activity with type, message, retryability, stack trace, and encoded details
read workflow or standalone host history
read the caller-observed failure
pass_criteria: failure type and message are preserved
failure details remain payload-codec compatible
non-retryable failures do not silently retry

scenarios.title: Heartbeat and cancellation observation
operations: heartbeat an in-flight activity with structured progress details
request cancellation of the owning workflow or standalone host
heartbeat again and capture the worker-observed cancellation flag
pass_criteria: heartbeat details are recorded in history or operator state
the worker receives cancel_requested=true after cancellation
the activity reaches a documented terminal cancellation or failure state

scenarios.title: PHP SDK heartbeat timeout renewal across enforcement passes
operations: install and execute the exact published durable-workflow/sdk worker against the exact published server artifact
heartbeat materially faster than a short heartbeat timeout while the activity remains in flight beyond the original timeout
run real activity timeout enforcement after every accepted heartbeat
stop heartbeating a negative-control attempt and issue late heartbeat, completion, and failure commands after typed timeout enforcement
pass_criteria: every accepted heartbeat advances the authoritative heartbeat deadline
multiple enforcement passes skip the renewed attempt without writing ActivityTimedOut
the renewed attempt completes exactly once and history records every accepted heartbeat without contradiction
the no-heartbeat control records a typed heartbeat timeout
late stale-attempt commands retain deterministic attempt_closed and stale_attempt responses
exact artifact identities, timestamps, enforcement responses, terminal histories, and isolated cleanup evidence are retained

scenarios.title: Idempotent completion handling
operations: complete an activity attempt successfully
repeat the same completion request after the first terminal record lands
inspect worker response and terminal history
pass_criteria: the first completion records exactly one terminal result
the duplicate completion receives a deterministic stale-attempt or idempotent response
history and operator state do not contain duplicate terminal activity records

scenarios.title: PHP and Python activity parity
operations: execute equivalent PHP and Python activities with typed payloads
compare result, failure, retry, timeout, heartbeat, and cancellation observations
record unsupported cells with focused findings if a published runtime lacks the activity surface
pass_criteria: supported PHP and Python activity cells expose compatible payload and failure shapes
the matrix records every unsupported surface with a root-cause finding
no runtime-specific source checkout is used as evidence

scenarios.title: Operator visible activity attempt state
operations: capture in-flight, retrying, timed-out, failed, completed, and cancelled activity attempt state
compare server API metrics, workflow history, Waterline selected-run/list evidence, and CLI JSON list/detail evidence
record activity attempt id, attempt number, status, heartbeat, retry, and deadline fields
pass_criteria: operators can see the current attempt and terminal status without reading database tables
Waterline displays activity attempt state for embedded and standalone activity runs where supported
CLI JSON list/detail output exposes activity execution ids and attempt rows where supported
missing observer fields are routed to a focused CLI, Waterline, or server product finding
